# 🔍 Code Review

## Review metadata

- Pull request:
- Reviewer:
- Commit reviewed:
- Date:
- Risk level:

## Product and correctness

- [ ] Change addresses the linked problem.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are observable and met.
- [ ] Existing behavior and rule precedence are preserved where required.
- [ ] Empty, boundary, and malformed input are handled.
- [ ] State changes and component responsibilities are clear.
- [ ] No unrequested feature or hidden scope was added.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] User content remains safely rendered as text.
- [ ] No unsafe HTML injection or evaluation was introduced.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or real transcripts are committed.
- [ ] Client-side environment variables contain no secrets.
- [ ] New network requests, storage, and third parties are documented.
- [ ] Errors do not expose sensitive data.

## Accessibility and UX

- [ ] Keyboard access and visible focus are preserved.
- [ ] Accessible names and states are correct.
- [ ] Live announcements are appropriate.
- [ ] Responsive behavior is reviewed.
- [ ] Reduced-motion behavior remains usable.
- [ ] Text remains readable at zoom.

## Engineering quality

- [ ] Code is understandable and scoped.
- [ ] Dependencies are justified.
- [ ] package.json and lockfile agree.
- [ ] Tests cover positive, negative, ambiguous, and precedence cases.
- [ ] Docs, diagrams, examples, and templates are updated.
- [ ] Lint, tests, audit, and build evidence is attached.

## Findings

| Severity | File / line | Finding | Required action |
|---|---|---|---|

## Decision

Approve / request changes / comment only. Record remaining risk, required follow-up, and exact commit reviewed.
